violet (auditor): Quick ask — suspected RBAC edit to infra/snapshotter at ~2026-07-20T22:47:00Z. We saw a KMS Decrypt spike alert. Provide a minimal, timeboxed evidence bundle for 2026-07-20T22:40:00Z -> 2026-07-20T22:55:00Z: RBAC delta, KMS Decrypt events, and any S3 GetObject ops tied to those decrypts.

chris: Acknowledged. We'll pull kube-apiserver audit for RoleBinding updates, IRSA annotations to map serviceAccount -> AWS role, CloudTrail Decrypt events filtered by key aliases alias/redwood-*, and S3 access rows.

dana: CLI snippets I will run: 
 kubectl --context=prod get events --all-namespaces --field-selector involvedObject.kind=RoleBinding -o json | jq '.items[] | select(.metadata.creationTimestamp >= "2026-07-20T22:40:00Z" and .metadata.creationTimestamp <= "2026-07-20T22:55:00Z")' > k8s_rbac_delta.json
 aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2026-07-20T22:40:00Z --end-time 2026-07-20T22:55:00Z --query 'Events[]' > kms_decrypts.json
 aws s3api select-object-content --bucket redwood-access-logs --key 2026/07/20/22/logs.gz --expression "SELECT s._1,s._7,s._10 WHERE s._1 BETWEEN '2026-07-20T22:40:00Z' AND '2026-07-20T22:55:00Z'" --expression-type SQL --output json > s3_reads.json

chris: Cross-correlation instructions: match decrypt.requestParameters.keyId and userIdentity.arn to IRSA-mapped role; then join on request_id or x-amz-request-id to S3 reads. Pull STS GetCallerIdentity and AssumeRole events if session timing ambiguous.

violet (auditor): Bundle expectations: include manifest.txt with checksums, extraction commands, a short correlation_map.txt with 1-line conclusion per decrypt (related/unrelated + why), and a redaction_log.

dana: We'll hash S3 object keys and redact user emails. Evidence zip will contain: manifest.txt, k8s_rbac_delta.json, irsa_map.txt, kms_decrypts.json, s3_reads.json, correlation_map.txt, redaction_log.txt, extract_cmds.sh.

logs-bot: Starting export job: snap_evidence_6290011223_20260720. Staging to s3://redwood-compliance-exports/. Presigned link to be generated (valid 7 days).

chris: I already see two Decrypt events: 22:42 (pre-edit) and 22:48 (post-edit). We'll verify session creation time for the 22:48 session. If session created prior to 22:47, it's unrelated.

violet (auditor): Good. If any decrypt shows anomalous object volume or unfamiliar principal, flag and escalate to oncall immediately.

logs-bot: Export complete: s3://redwood-compliance-exports/snap_evidence_6290011223_20260720.zip (presigned: https://presigned.example/ev/6290011223). Manifest SHA256: 9c56a1f2...

dana: Uploaded and annotated correlation_map.txt. Closing unless auditor requests follow-up.

violet (auditor): Downloading now. Thanks team 44d. Will reopen thread if we need deeper forensic artifacts.
